item.title: Black Wolf
item.description:
• Made by and purchased from Ocicat in 2003.
  • Debuted at JerseyDevilCon 2003.
  • Partial suit. Head, paws and tail. Meant to be worn with street clothes.

item.title: Chestnut Husky
item.description:
• Purchased from Wildfox in August 2006.
  • Made by Ocicat.
  • Debuted at Pompton Day Festival.
  • Named for the cross street (Chestnut Ridge Road) where I used to live in Northern New Jersey.
  • Primary fursuit for mascot gigs because he is soft and kid-friendly.
  • Refurbishing by MicroMascots completed March 2011.

item.title: Coyote
item.description:
• Purchased from TJCoyote in 2004.
  • Made by Ocicat.
  • Debuted at Anthrocon 2004.

item.title: Grey Wolf
item.description:
• Made by and purchased from Fallimar in February 2006.
  • Debuted at the Middletown, CT, Penguin Plunge.

item.title: K2 Coyote
item.description:
• Purchased from Wildfox in February 2011.
  • Made by Ocicat.
  • Debuted at Delaware Furbowl in May 2011.
  • First con was Anthrocon 2011, where I walked around the con with a made-up "Kinzer II" badge without telling anyone who I really was. He got quite a bit of attention.

item.title: Kinzer Coyote
item.description:
• Purchased from Wildfox in March 2010.
  • Made by Ocicat.
  • Debuted at Delaware Furbowl in June 2010.
  • Named for the first town I stopped at (Kinzers, PA) on my way to Anthrocon 2010.

item.title: Lion
item.description:
• Purchased at Things Unlimited, a thrift store in Virginia Beach, in 2000.
  • Not worn in public yet.
  • Simple one-piece design. Head, hands, and feet are all attached.

item.title: Minsi the Meerkat
item.description:
• Purchased from Wildfox in April 2015.
  • Made by MoonFox.
  • Debuted at Fur The 'More 2015.

item.title: Oddbrand Otter
item.description:
• Purchased from Silivenist in September 2010.
  • Made by Hindpaws.
  • Named for the Asgardian otter character Oddbrand.
  • After several evenings of work to alter the bodysuit size and make fursuit sandals, I debuted him at the Walk Now for Autism Speaks event at Jones Beach in Long Island in early October 2010.

item.title: Rakket Raccoon
item.description:
• Purchased from Wildwolf in November 2013.
  • Made by Wildwolf.
  • Debuted at Delaware Furbowl L in December 2013.
  • First con was Fur the 'More 2014 in March 2014.

item.title: Salts Raccoon
item.description:
• Purchased from Wildfox in January 2009.
  • Made by Ocicat.
  • Debuted at Anthrocon 2009.
  • I crowdsourced his name by asking on Twitter and Friendfeed for suggestions. I picked "Salts" because there's an amusing story behind it. This was the name of someone's pet raccoon. It's short for Saltpetre because the raccoon had a habit of interrupting them during sex.

item.title: Unicorn
item.description:
• Purchased at Things Unlimited, a thrift store in Virginia Beach, in 2000.
  • Debuted at Anthrocon 2002.
  • Simple one-piece design. Head, hands, and feet are all attached.
